patterns.message: @fgaudo/effect-tea is independent of the renderer: views are generic over their node type, and only the code that renders knows the renderer.

A testing tool runs a program on the engine, and makes no step, no scope of a subscription or a command, and no site of a defect (docs/invariants.md, "The testing tools behave like the engine"): it takes of core.ts and shell.ts only the names listed here, each a reviewed edit of this list.

no-restricted-properties.message: A call of a testing tool waits only as the stage lets it (testing/stage.ts): before it has applied anything, raced with a death (`waiting`, `afterJobs`), and once it has applied its message, for its job whole (what `apply` and `dispatch` return).
